name: Blink
description: Teleports you up to 7 tiles away so long as no wall blocks the path.

name: Bubble Shield 1
description: Surrounds you with bubbles for 12s blocking enemies.  Pets and group can move through them.  Bubbles will break after 5 hits from an aisling, or 10 from a monster.

name: Call Lightning 1
description: After 2s delay, strike chosen location 5 times.  Damage scales with your mana, and has a 75% chance to apply crit.

name: Cloudburst 1
description: Every splashed enemy within 10 tiles swells into a greater splash, spreading its damage to enemies within 2 tiles instead of 1.  Their remaining duration is preserved.  Cannot be cast with nothing splashed.

name: Cyclone 1
description: Summons a wind tornado for 8s.  Every 0.5s it pushes enemies on or beside it 1 tile away.  Bosses are not moved and aislings can pass through.

name: Earth Barrier 1
description: Raise a barrier of earth that absorbs damage equal to 50% of your max mana.  Casting again will stack more barriers, up to a cap of 50% of your max health.  After 20s without taking damage it loses 10% of what is left each second.

name: Ember Ward 1
description: For 20s your spells have +25% spell damage and +300 flat spell damage on every spell hit.

name: Fire Wall 1
description: Creates a 2x5 wall of fire in front of you for 8s.  Every 0.5s enemies standing in it take 4% of their max health (less against bosses), with a 20% chance to burn.  Sal spells cast can extinguish.

name: Galeform 1
description: For 20s you gain -20 AC, +25 MR and 15% faster assails.

name: Groo 1
description: Strikes a chosen area that cascades outward 2 tiles.  Damage scales with your mana, and has a 25% chance to apply Beag Suain.

name: Ignis 1
description: Strike a chosen area that cascades outwards 2 tiles.  Damage scales with your mana and has a 25% chance to apply burn.

name: Keeter 1
description: Strike a chosen area that cascades outward 2 spaces.  Damage scales with your mana, and has a 25% chance to apply crit.

name: Meteor 1
description: Call down a meteor on target, cascading outward 2 tiles and leaving fire behind.  Damage scales with your mana, and has a 75% chance to apply burn.

name: Mud Wall 1
description: Surrounds a target with walls of mud for 12s.  You and your group may pass through.  Each wall breaks after 5 hits from an aisling, or 10 from a monster.

name: Nera 1
description: Strikes a chosen area that cascades outward 2 more tiles.  Damage scales with your mana and has a 25% chance to apply splash.

name: Proliferation 1
description: Every burning enemy within 10 tiles spreads its fire to the foe beside it.  It's own burn is refreshed to full duration.  Cannot be cast with nothing burning.

name: Seismic Shift 1
description: Spell cascades outward in a cone up to 3 tiles, striking enemies and pushing them away.  Damage scales with your mana, and has a 75% chance to apply Beag Suain.

name: Static Field 1
description: Surrounds a friendly target for 10s.  Every 0.5s enemies on all sides are marked with crit, and next spell/skill deals 30% more damage.  The field itself deals no damage.

name: Subsuming Sands 1
description: Tears open a rift of sand for 8s.  Every 1.2s it deals 200 + 8*INT to enemies within 2 tiles and drags them towards the center.  Anything caught in the eye takes double damage.  Bosses are hit, but not pulled.

name: Tidal Wave 1
description: Sends a wave of water cascading outward in a cone up to 5 tiles.  Damage scales with your mana, and has a 75% chance to apply splash.

name: Tidewell 1
description: Opens a well beneath your magic, returning 10% of your max mana every 2s for 20s.
